entries.clue: Husks of milled wheat; at a fete, the filling of a lucky-dip tub
Chopped straw or hay stirred into a feed bucket; also, to tease
Pavement game of numbered squares, a pebble and one-legged jumps
Knobbly joint at the lower end of the cannon bone, booted when jumping
Quiet room of borrowed books and date stamps
Job of the two on the works roof so the machines need not stop at an alert
Rubber respirator issued to every civilian against an attack that never came
Nightly rule against showing any light, in force from September 1939
One of the three stretches of the year: autumn, spring and summer
Keeper of the keys and the mop, first in and last to lock up
